company_info.description: Mandom Corporation engages in the manufacturing and sales of cosmetics and perfumes in Japan, Indonesia, and internationally. It offers hair styling products, such as wax, grease, gel, foam, spray, water, and tonic and liquid; body, toner, deodorant, fragrance, moisturizing care, shampoo, foot care, and hair removal; hair care and hair coloring products, including shampoo and conditioner, coloring, treatment; face products comprising toner, skin care, cleansing, makeup remover, and shaving; and point makeup products. The company is also involved in manufacture and sale of quasi-drugs. It sells its products under the aono, Baby Veil, Barrier Repair, Bifesta, CYQ, GATSBY, GB, Happy Deo, HOLIDEA, ium, Levata, LUCIDO, LUCIDO-L, M4, MANDOM, Simplity, SLEPIA, T/ME U, TANCHO, ZFACE brand names. In addition, it engages in the insurance agency business. The company was formerly known as Tancho Corporation and changed its name to Mandom Corporation in April 1971. Mandom Corporation was incorporated in 1927 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
